observer_and_input_source:
local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu']
local space=cpu.spaces['program']
local function field(port,name) for _,f in pairs(manager.machine.ioport.ports[port].fields) do if f.name==name then return f end end error('input missing') end
local mode=field(':PANEL1','Mode')
local up=field(':PANEL1','Panel Up')
local inc=field(':PANEL0','S2')
local dec=field(':PANEL0','S1')
local exit=field(':PANEL1','Exit')
mode:set_value(0)
local frames=0
local stage=4
local cooldown=0
local held=nil
local writes=0
scsi_tap=space:install_write_tap(0xe400,0xe41f,'boot-scsi',function(a,d,m)
if writes<4096 then print(string.format('[SCSI] pc=%04x addr=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,a,d,m)) end writes=writes+1
end)
handoff=space:install_write_tap(0x0106,0x0107,'handoff',function(a,d,m) print(string.format('[HANDOFF] pc=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',cpu.state['PC'].value,d,m)) end)
local function pulse(f,name) f:set_value(1) held=f cooldown=30 print('[INPUT] '..name) end
emu.register_frame_done(function()
frames=frames+1
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value
if held then held:set_value(0) held=nil end
if cooldown>0 then cooldown=cooldown-1 end
if stage==0 then
 mode:set_value(0)
 if frames>90 and pc>=0x5741 and pc<=0x5809 then mode:set_value(0) stage=1 cooldown=30 print('[ENTERED] setup') end
elseif stage==1 and cooldown==0 then
 local selection=space:read_u8(0x4d30)
 if selection>1 then pulse(up,'Panel Up') elseif selection==1 then stage=2 cooldown=30 else error('unexpected selection') end
elseif stage==2 and cooldown==0 then
 local boot=space:read_u8(0x4caf)
 if boot<2 then pulse(inc,'S2') elseif boot>2 then pulse(dec,'S1') else stage=3 cooldown=30 end
elseif stage==3 and cooldown==0 then pulse(exit,'Exit') stage=4 end
if frames%60==0 then print(string.format('[STATE] frame=%d pc=%04x stage=%d field=%02x boot=%02x target=%02x type=%02x',frames,pc,stage,space:read_u8(0x4d30),space:read_u8(0x4caf),space:read_u8(0x4c51),space:read_u8(0x4c5b))) end
end)

local polls={}
scsi_read=space:install_read_tap(0xe408,0xe40d,'scsi-poll',function(a,d,m)
local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value
if pc>=0x25a3 and pc<=0x25c1 then local key=string.format('pc=%04x addr=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',pc,a,d,m) polls[key]=(polls[key] or 0)+1 end
end)
local pollframes=0
emu.register_frame_done(function() pollframes=pollframes+1 if pollframes==1740 then for k,v in pairs(polls) do print('[POLL] '..k..' count='..v) end end end)
